reason: My Booking score is my whole business, and I am not letting a new one-man company's robot talk to my guests. If it gives one wrong answer about parking or check-out and someone writes it in a review, my 9.4 becomes 9.1 and I lose more than it costs.
objection: Who are these people? If the company disappears in a year or the AI says something stupid to a German family, my reviews pay for it. And €150 plus €35 a month is a lot from what I earn on one apartment, when I already answer guests myself on WhatsApp.
would_change_my_mind: Seeing it working for a year at a neighbour's apartment I know, with their review score not dropping, and paying nothing until I see that myself.
